text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
"Hey hey! Did you see Falco-chan's race 
the other day!?"

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
I saw it! Man, back then, the crowd's 
energy was seriously out of this world~!

Smart Falcon's popularity was surging so 
much that you'd often hear about her just 
walking around town. Meanwhile, she 
herself—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Urrrmmmph...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'm sorry. I was just watching 
Haiseiko-san's races from his active days.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah, look. Look at how decisively she 
won the Nakayama Kinen."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Not just her talent as an umadol, but it 
was because she had the true skill worthy 
of being called the "Monster-chan" that 
Haiseiko-san shone so brightly.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"...And so, I realized. To give the best 
live performance, you need the best race. 
To run the best race, you need the best 
stride."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
For that sake—Falco wants to polish her 
running more and more!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
That's why! I want to do special training 
to push my unique strength—my 
"Front-Running"—to its absolute limits!
choice_data_list:
Special training, huh... What will we be 
doing?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Fufu☆ I've got an idea for that. So 
Trainer, lend me a hand, okay?☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for gathering for Falco's special 
training today, everyone~!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Not at all. Thank *you* for inviting me.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Still, it's pretty much all the usual 
faces who compete on dirt together. Feels 
just like the real deal, don't it?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yes! For this special training, I want to 
do it in an actual race format!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I thought about all kinds of training 
routines, but... to really polish my true 
worth, nothing beats a serious match after 
all!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Only by pulling off a runaway victory 
against strong opponents can Falco truly 
master her individuality... That's what I 
thought!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: I see. I understand your reasons, but—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
We don't plan on letting you get away that 
easily either~♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Everyone, aim for the top with your 
own style of running! Let's polish each 
other's sparkle that way☆

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, what!? It's Falco-san! Whoa, the 
rest of the lineup is stacked too...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
She's been at it non-stop since noon. 
Covered from head to toe in mud, giving it 
her all…… I gotta hand it to her.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: ...... Still... somehow.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. Pretty cool, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... One more lap, please! Is 
everyone good to go!?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
This is just the beginning! I'll show you 
Funabashi's true grit...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
(As expected of everyone...! Even after 
running this much, far from slowing down— 
their strides are only getting sharper!)

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
(Still, I won't lose either! I'll shine 
brighter than anyone—captivate more than 
anyone! I'll master my Front Running!)

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Let's gooooo!!!!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
—They're working so hard, Falco-chan and 
the others.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, it's been a while.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
...That's so nice. Seeing that brings back 
memories of when I first jumped into the 
racing world.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Even covered in mud, giving it her all and 
shining brightly— ...No.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
It's fascinating, isn't it? It's precisely 
because she looks that way that Falco-chan 
shines all the brighter—
choice_data_list: Because that is her greatest charm.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: ...I see. So that's why it's so—

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
...... Trainer-san. Please, do what you 
can to support her.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Because I'm sure this time right now... 
will become a truly shining memory for 
Falco-chan.

Seeing Smart Falcon and the others shining 
brightly even while covered in mud, this 
moment firmly solidified my resolve to 
support them even more.
